full_judgment: 10. Mr. Md. Abdus Samad Miah, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that the learned Courts below erred in law in convicting the accused petitioners without properly discussing and considering the evidence on record and as such the impugned order of conviction and sentence is not maintain-able in law. The learned Advocate further submits that the prosecution has withheld a number of material witnesses without any satisfactory explanation and as such an adverse presumption under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act should have been drawn against the prosecution and the accused petitioners acquitted of the charges leveled against them. The learned Advocate further submits that the prosecution has failed to proved the charge under section 325 of the Penal Code with reference to the medical evidence and consequently the impugned order of conviction and sentence u/s 325 of the Penal Code is liable to be set aside.
